AuthoredLocation.description: Where somebody starts: a place, and optionally where in it and which way they face.

facing.description: Which way they face, in millidegrees clockwise (90000 is a quarter turn; 360000 is a whole turn).

place.description: Which place, by its authoring key.

position.description: Where in it, in millimetres from the place's own origin.

AuthoredPosition.description: A position inside a place: integer millimetres on the world's own axes.

x.description: Millimetres across the floor from the place's origin.

y.description: Millimetres across the floor from the place's origin, at right angles to `x`.

z.description: Millimetres of height. Absent means the floor, which is what a world that does not model height means.

EntityKey.description: An authoring key: the name of a file in people/, places/, items/ or organizations/ without .yaml. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

Millimetres.description: A length or a coordinate, in whole millimetres (1 m = 1000).

Tag.description: One label, such as cafe or night-shift. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

Tags.description: Labels this entity carries; a tag listed twice counts once. Systems and clients read tags, never prose.

description: people/<key>.yaml: one Person. Besides these fields, the file may carry the sections of the System Packs the world enables (see sections.md); any other key is refused.

location.description: Where this person starts: a place, and optionally where in it and which way they face. Needs the presence system.

note.description: A note from whoever wrote the file, for a person reading it. No system reads it.

tags.description: Labels this person carries, such as shopkeeper.

title: Person file
